name: Generate SEO-optimized YouTube video metadata
description: Users asked the assistant to generate or optimize SEO metadata, including titles, descriptions, keywords, and hashtags, for YouTube videos and Shorts. The requests frequently included specific formatting instructions, such as converting content to Hinglish or ensuring keywords are comma-separated, to improve search visibility and engagement.
